svg.title: Khedival Cairo facade 02 — stepped crown and Gothic bay studies
svg.desc: Source-informed visible front elevation. Narrow high central staircase wraps one large pointed recess; crenellated parapet steps above central bays, two upper opening tiers, tall pointed third tier, three lower residential tiers with single/pair alternation, a sixth single-opening tier behind continuous baluster terrace, stone round-arch arcade and blank rectangular ground shops. Details and dimensions remain interpretive.
